newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says finds new Cooper/Eromonga field.
newsitem.headline: Santos says finds new Cooper/Eromonga field.

text.p: Oil and gas explorer and producer Santos Ltd said on Thursday it has discovered a new gas field in the South Australian section of the Cooper/Eromanga basins.
Santos said Dorodillo-1 flowed gas at 10.0 million cubic feet per day over the interval 2,485-2,492 metres through a 0.5 inch surface choke.
Dorodillo is two kilometres north-east of the Arrakis North-1 gas well and about 24 kilometres west-south-west of Moomba.

"The discovery is particularly encouraging because it is a clear demonstration of a commercial gas flow rate from a stratigraphically trapped gas play," said Santos' South Australian business unit general manager Mike Hannell.
The discovery, in the Murta block, was close to existing infrastructure and also enhanced the area's exploration potential, Hannell said in a statement.
The new field follows last week's announcement of a possible resource of several hundred billion cubic feet of gas in the Barrolka Field complex, in the Queensland section of the basin.
Santos is the operator and holds a 59.75 percent interest in the Murta block.

Other participants are Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd, a unit of Exxon Corp, with 20.21 percent, Boral Ltd's Boral Energy Resources Ltd, with 13.19 percent, Gulf Canada unit Gulf (Aust) Reources NL, with 4.75 percent, and Cultus Petroleum Ltd's Basin Oil NL with 2.10 percent.
